verdict.rationale: Babylon.js core is an Apache-2.0 library published on npm (@babylonjs/core 9.26.1, confirmed by a runtime probe). It ships as modular, tree-shakable ES6 packages, so you can install, bundle and serve it entirely from your own infrastructure. Server-side use via NullEngine is also documented. Missing for 10: evidence that the hosted companion tools (Playground, Sandbox, Node Material Editor) can be self-hosted, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment.
